sentences.text: Hello, I'm calling to book a table for tonight, please.
A table for 4, at around 7:30 PM.
Let me check... Yes, we have a table available then. May I have your name?
Great. You table for 4 will be ready at 7:30.
Thank you very much. See you then.
You're welcome. Have a nice day!
Hello, I'd like to reserve a table for two at 8:00 PM tonight.
I'm so sorry, but we are completely full for the entire evening.
Oh, I see. What about earlier, perhaps around 5:30?
I'm afraid not. We have no tables available for any time today.
That's a shame. Well, thank you anyway!
You're very welcome. I'm sorry we couldn't accommodate you today.
No problem at all. Have a good night!
